resourceSampler.definition: sum resident RSS of benchmark Node process and all native descendants, excluding PostgreSQL server daemon; sampled with ps

termination: SIGINT sent to standalone benchmark Node after actual repeated full custom-table scan/sort was observed; source database, original encrypted recovery backup, trusted baseline and committed batch journal retained.
finding: The custom EXISTS predicate preceded keyset LIMIT, allowing PostgreSQL to choose a parallel full-table scan/sort and project TOAST documents repeatedly.
remediation: Materialized lightweight PK frontier before eligibility filtering, then bounded lateral PK document reads. Empty eligible frontiers still advance and checkpoint the full frontier.
resume: Original trusted baseline and recovery artifact will be reused; no new baseline may be made from partially rotated data.
performanceDisposition: Interrupted run is diagnostic and correctness evidence only. Fresh final 20GiB warm/cold acceptance remains pending.
